title: [Feature] Add persistent drop monitor functionality
author: arista-hpandya
body:
**Description:**

This issue tracks the implementation of the persistent drop monitor feature within sonic-swss, as described in the SONiC drop counter monitoring HLD. This feature will enable the monitoring of drop counters against configurable thresholds, enhancing network troubleshooting capabilities.

**Tasks:**
- [x] Implement the logic to monitor drop counters against configured thresholds.
- [x] Add support for the following configurable parameters:
    - [x] Status (enabled/disabled toggle)
    - [x] Window size (sliding time window in seconds)
    - [x] Drop count threshold (minimum drops per window for an incident)
    - [x] Incident count threshold (minimum incidents to trigger a persistent drop alert)
- [x] Implement the logic to track incidents within the specified window size.
- [x] Implement the logic to generate persistent drop alerts when the incident count threshold is met.
- [x] Add unit test to add code coverage for the feature 

**Background:**

The persistent drop monitor feature enhances the existing SONiC drop counter functionality by adding the ability to monitor for sustained drop patterns. The `drop_monitor.lua` script will be responsible for implementing the core logic of this feature, including monitoring drop counters, tracking incidents, and generating persistent drop alerts.

**References:**
- Umbrella issue tracking the feature development: https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/issues/1542
- HLD Documentation of the feature: https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/pull/1912

**Note: This change depends on https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss-common/pull/971**
Fixes #3501 
HLD:  https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/pull/1912

**What I did**
- Added logic to read configuration from the DEBUG_DROP_MONITOR table.
- Added logic to register persistent alerts when the conditions are met.
- Added logic to toggle the feature off if desired on a per-counter level.

**Why I did it**
To implement the persistent drop counter monitoring feature which allows users to configure thresholds for drop counters and register alerts when persistent drops are detected.

**How I verified it**
- Existing unit tests were run using `make check` to ensure no functionality was affected.
- New unit tests have been added to verify the functionality.
- Manual testing was performed on a SONiC switch to verify that the orchagent correctly reads the configuration, generates alerts when thresholds are met, and can be toggled off/on.

**Details if related**
The configurable drop monitor feature reads he status (enabled/disabled) from the DEBUG_DROP_MONITOR table. The orchagent periodically (every minute) polls the drop counters and compares the counts against the configured thresholds. If the thresholds are exceeded, the orchagent generates a persistent alert which is stored in the `PERSISTENT_DROP_ALERTS` table in Counters DB. The feature can be toggled on/off for all drop counters or it can be turned on/off for a specific drop counter. The corresponding CLI to do so can be found in the CLI PR attached in the umbrella issue: https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/issues/1542
